title: change_request.v1
description: One change request (SUP.10 BP1, BP2, BP4): a fenced ```yaml change_request block in the body of a host issue labelled change-request; the issue's number is its ID, named by the commits that implement it (#<n>). The analysis — affected items and size — is required once the status is past requested, the dependencies must be change requests and the affected items must exist: those are rules of check_change_record_gate and verify_change_trace_gate, not of this schema.

what.description: What is asked, in one line.

initiator.description: Who asks for it: a role or a person (BP1).

affected.description: What it changes, by identifier (BP2, BP4).

depends_on.description: The change requests it depends on, by issue number (BP2).

size.description: Relative size, as for requirements (SWE.1 BP3).

problem.description: The problem issue that caused it, when one did (BP4, SUP.9 BP5).
